name: Lust or Heaven
source:
You awaken in a cell. Cold stone, dripping water. How did you get here? Why does everything ache? Only a few weeks ago, you were Robert Night—a talented but deeply lonely architecture student. Life was a predictable rhythm of lectures, blueprints, and the silence of your dorm room.

Then she appeared. Julia. Quiet. Subtle. And utterly unfathomable. Your curiosity became your prison.

Party. Dark hallway. A perfect stranger whose touch sears and whose gaze sees straight into your soul. One night of passion—and your world shatters.

You've come face-to-face with an Ancient Evil. A succubus, thousands of years old, who knows you better than you know yourself. She offers pleasure twisted with unbearable pain. She is your Warden and your Judge, offering you a chance to face your true self—at the cost of your sanity, or even your life.

Can you unravel the mystery of your captivity? Journey from loneliness into a living nightmare. Make choices that lead to salvation or damnation. Confront ghosts of your past and demons of your present. Time is ticking... and your choices are the only thing that's real.

Who are you: the victim, the player, or the judge? Experience a story of loneliness, forbidden desire, supernatural horror, and the battle for your soul. Every choice is a step toward salvation or eternal darkness. Time is ticking...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3312400/Lust_or_Heaven]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你在牢房中醒来。冰冷的石头，滴着水。你是怎么到这里来的？为什么一切都疼痛？就在几周前，你还是罗伯特·奈特——一位才华横溢但非常孤独的建筑系学生。生活是一种可预测的节奏，包括讲座、蓝图和宿舍的寂静。

然后她出现了。朱莉娅.安静的。微妙的。而且完全深不可测。你的好奇心成了你的监狱。

派对。黑暗的走廊。一个完全陌生的人，他的触摸灼热，他的目光直视你的灵魂。一夜的激情——你的世界崩溃了。

你正面对了远古邪恶。一个数千岁的魅魔，她比你更了解你自己。她提供的快乐与难以忍受的痛苦交织在一起。她是你的典狱长和法官，为你提供一个面对真实自我的机会——但代价是你的理智，甚至是你的生命。

你能解开你被囚禁的谜团吗？从孤独变成活生生的噩梦。做出导致救赎或诅咒的选择。面对过去的幽灵和现在的恶魔。时间在流逝……而你的选择是唯一真实的。

你是谁：受害者、玩家还是法官？体验一个关于孤独、禁忌欲望、超自然恐怖和灵魂之战的故事。每一个选择都是迈向救赎或永恒黑暗的一步。时间在流逝……

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3312400/Lust_or_Heaven]Steam[/url]]
